title: TSAI Type Metadata
description: The type-metadata document for a TSAI vct (SD-JWT VC type metadata, §4). Declares per-claim mandatory presence and selective-disclosure controls, plus display.

vct.description: The credential type this metadata describes

claims.description: Per-claim controls; the identity floor is mandatory, reputation is sd: never

path.description: SD-JWT VC claim path; for a scalar top-level claim

signal.description: TSAI selector addressing a signal by category and type, since signals are array elements

sd.description: Selective-disclosure control; reputation MUST be never
